title: Dominion Energy Ohio Earns 2023 Energy Star Partner of the Year Award
summary: Program Lauded for providing customers with $1.2 million in rebates Recognition for contributions to clean energy Program boosts home comfort, long-term value, lower energy bills CLEVELAND, April 12 — Dominion Energy Ohio is proud to announce it has received the 2023 ENERGY STAR Partner of the Year Award – Energy Efficiency Program Delivery from the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency and the U.S. Department of Energy. Dominion Energy Ohio was recognized for its Home Performance with Energy Star program, a residential home energy assessment program. The award recognizes companies that have made outstanding contributions in the transition to a clean energy future. “Our company is committed to achieving net zero by 2050 and energy efficiency will be key in helping us deliver on our promise.
